answer:
I renamed the Amt column to "Amount (kr)" in Household expenses.

The page looked up that column by its old name, so the rename would have broken it. I changed that lookup to accept the new name, and it still accepts the old one. I didn't open the page after the change, so I haven't seen it render. It should still show the total and the list of items.

The page also doesn't use the app's own colours, and it sets a background on the page body. I left both alone because you only asked for the rename.
